messages:
Maya (CS): Quick roundup from Lighthouse Retail onboarding call — capturing raw asks so we can triage. TL;DR: billing granularity, embedding freshness controls, resilient fallback behavior. Threading these for product/eng owners.

Jon (CSM): dropping my shorthand notes from the call: 
- Billing by route/feature (search vs summarization) — customer needs chargebacks to internal teams.
- Control over embedding refresh interval per account — they run daily re-indexes but want flexibility.
- Auto-fallback to cheaper model + clear canned message when primary unavailable.

Priya (Product): please mark impact level (blocker/major/minor) and whether UI or infra work.

Jon (CSM): added impact inline: 
- Billing by route -> Impact: blocker for finance reconciliation (UI + backend).
- Embedding refresh interval -> Impact: major; UX for search relevance (backend + ML infra).
- Auto-fallback + customer-facing message -> Impact: blocker; affects renewal confidence (runtime + routing).

Sam (PM): can each proposed owner add a 1-line mitigation and target ETA? We need something to share in Wed sync.

Maya (CS): quick ownership mapping: 
- Billing by route -> Finance + Platform (billing API + billing UI).
- Embedding cadence -> ML infra + Backend jobs.
- Fallback behavior -> Runtime + Traffic routing.

Noah (AE): Lighthouse signals they'll delay renewal without a resilience plan. I can get them an extension if we have a solid short-term mitigation next week. Renewal date: 2026-05-10.

Priya (Product): preliminary prioritization: fallback resilience (P0), billing by route (P1), embedding cadence (P2). I'll finalize after owners post ETAs.

Jon (CSM): customer also requested a temporary toggle to disable embeddings on certain routes to reduce cost. Suggested as a stopgap.

Sam (PM): add toggle as a short-term action item (workaround). Good catch.

ops-bot: new feedback form received from Lighthouse Retail (3 items). Link: https://redwood.co/cs/forms/5189991234

Maya (CS): I'll paste verbatim quotes into Confluence page /cs/triage/5189991234 and link here. Example: "We need to show per-feature cost to justify adding new product lines." — CFO.

Priya (Product): owners: please post your 1-line mitigations + ETA in the triage doc by EOD tomorrow. I'll convert into a short roadmap slice and propose a canary mitigation for the Wed customer call.

Noah (AE): will push for Wed but prefer Thu if needed.

Maya (CS): thanks all — closing thread once triage doc has owners. If you have extra call snippets, paste here.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): End.
